name: Code Blocks
summary: Run a code block in your space and see its output inline, like a notebook cell.
description: Adds an Execute permission and a run command. A member who holds the permission can run a code block; the module executes it in slim-m's sandbox and posts the output. JavaScript first.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Execute code blocks
permissions.description: Run a code block in this space and post its output.

extension_points.name: run
extension_points.description: Run the code block and post its output.
